record.title: Coordinated farmer blockades on Spain–France and Spain–Andorra frontier roads, June 2024
record.scope: Coordinated blockade episode at selected frontier road approaches; movement restrictions varied by post
record.crossings: La Jonquera/AP-7–A9; Biriatou/Irún; Somport; Portalet; Bòssost; Puigcerdà; Coll d’Ares; La Seu d’Urgell–Andorra route
record.direction: Both directions at some approaches; Biriatou restrictions especially affected freight towards France.
record.movement: Road freight and passenger vehicles, with movement-specific exceptions.
record.exceptions: Light vehicles admitted selectively at some points; overnight passage and alternating flows differed by site.
record.imposing_authority: Agricultural protest groups on both sides, with police traffic diversions
record.enforcement: Tractors and protesters blocked roads; traffic agencies and local reporting document effects and resumption.
record.consequences: Diversions and persistent truck queues after barriers cleared.
record.relationship: Promotes June 2024 Pyrenees phase from EU-L017; distinct from Polish and Slovak blockade records. Coordinated episode is one row, not eight independent decisions.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.official_rationale: Protesters sought tougher import requirements, preference for local products and reduced production-energy taxes.
record.context: Action timed before European elections; economic demands support coding, without assuming an electoral motive.
record.uncertainty: Sites did not share identical onset, scope or continuity. Tractor removal alone is not endpoint evidence; later traffic confirmations are used.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Explicit overnight interruption at Somport/Portalet and staggered other gates prohibit a single uninterrupted duration.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: Wire and local reports describe blocked specified frontier roads and trucks.
June 3 actual onset supported; sites differ in time and traffic.
June 4 traffic authority confirmation and moving trucks supported; no single universal minute.

Hierarchical coding: see Rationale coding for subcategories, attribution and phases. The recorded rationale and claim assessment support the selected subcategories. All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): Import controls, local production and energy-tax demands support trade/protectionism.
Named road approaches and Andorra route at La Seu; not total border seal, diversion routes existed.
Somport/Portalet traffic normalized overnight before renewed June 4 morning obstruction; no continuous pooled interval.
